**Readiness risk:** a docs-only change path should not mark every gate as required. If the diff maps docs-only changes to the full required gate profile, it can block otherwise-ready documentation updates on unrelated product, runtime, package, integration, or policy gates. That creates false negatives in readiness, increases queue friction, and makes the readiness signal less trustworthy because “required” no longer means “required for this change’s actual blast radius.”
